query:
UPDATE forum_topic_comment c SET
             favor_count = v."favor!",
             contra_count = v."contra!"
           FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE stance = 'favor') AS "favor!",
                        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE stance = 'contra') AS "contra!"
                   FROM forum_comment_vote WHERE comment_id = $1) v
           WHERE c.id = $1
